# orm commands

Every `orm` command, with the arguments and options the console actually defines.

## `orm:diff`

Show differences between code schema and database

```bash
bin/semitexa orm:diff
```

| option | takes a value |
|---|---|
| `--connection` | yes |

## `orm:fresh`

Drop every table and sync the schema from code (development only; deletes all data)

```bash
bin/semitexa orm:fresh
```

| option | takes a value |
|---|---|
| `--connection` | yes |
| `--seed` | no |

## `orm:seed`

Run defaults() upsert for all Resource classes with seed data

```bash
bin/semitexa orm:seed
```

## `orm:status`

Show ORM status: database info, server capabilities, schema summary

```bash
bin/semitexa orm:status
```

| option | takes a value |
|---|---|
| `--connection` | yes |

## `orm:sync`

Synchronize ORM schema with the database

```bash
bin/semitexa orm:sync
```

| option | takes a value |
|---|---|
| `--connection` | yes |
| `--dry-run` | no |
| `--allow-destructive` | no |
| `--output` | yes |
